research_question: 上海内环建成环境与观测活动的关系如何随空间尺度变化？
sampling: Two independently retained random samples of at most 200000 observed stays per day, not 10% of UUIDs and not seven days.
outcome: log_stay_count = log1p(total sampled stays per eligible grid)
eligibility: Existing two-day eligible cells, >=10 unique devices in each cell-day; missing/suppressed outcome not recoded as zero.
support_correction: Events and features use the same clipped AOI grid. Supplied tables incorporate the 2026-08-30 AOI correction. This run does not redo raw event aggregation.

variables.cmab_building_density_per_ha: 建筑数量密度，每公顷建筑数量
variables.cmab_volume_proxy_per_ha: 每公顷建筑体量代理，m3/ha，不是实际建筑面积
variables.osm_road_density_m_per_ha: 道路长度，m/ha，不等于实际可达性

analysis_scope: Same eight variables, all seven supports. Agent proposes fixed and adaptive bandwidths. No predefined best route or required node count.
coefficient_interpretation: Full-sample coefficients describe conditional spatial associations. Compare common native-unit increments; within-scale standardized coefficients also reflect scale-specific dispersion. Changing support changes observations/sample coverage.
auxiliary_validation: Shared geographic groups are supplied for optional OOF prediction diagnostics, not a requirement for rejecting all local exploration.
boundaries: Two-day observed stays are not resident population
Fixed grid origin and geometry; not a full zoning experiment
